title: Bail Application (India — regular/anticipatory)
description: Application seeking release on bail before a Session Court or High Court. Provision numbers are NOT pre-filled: the applicable bail provision must be filled from the retrieved sources for the case.

required_fields.name: court
required_fields.description: Court seized of the matter (e.g. Court of Session at __ / High Court at __).
required_fields.retrieval_query: court of session high court seized of the matter bail application

required_fields.name: applicant_name
required_fields.description: Full name of the accused/applicant.
required_fields.retrieval_query: accused applicant name FIR chargesheet remand order

required_fields.name: applicant_address
required_fields.description: Permanent address (relevant to flight-risk assessment).
required_fields.retrieval_query: accused permanent address residence flight risk FIR

required_fields.name: case_number
required_fields.description: Case/crime number as registered.
required_fields.retrieval_query: case crime number registered FIR chargesheet Sessions case

required_fields.name: fir_number
required_fields.description: FIR number.
required_fields.retrieval_query: FIR number police station first information report registered

required_fields.name: fir_date
required_fields.description: Date of FIR registration.
required_fields.retrieval_query: FIR date registration first information report lodged on

required_fields.name: police_station
required_fields.description: Police station, with district and state.
required_fields.retrieval_query: police station district state FIR jurisdiction

required_fields.name: provisions_invoked
required_fields.description: Offence provisions as recorded in the FIR/chargesheet. Fill verbatim from sources; never invent.
required_fields.retrieval_query: offence provisions sections invoked FIR chargesheet IPC BNSS

required_fields.name: bail_provision
required_fields.description: Bail provision relied upon (regular/anticipatory). Fill from statute sources; never pre-filled here.
required_fields.retrieval_query: bail provision regular anticipatory bail statute section non-bailable bailable

required_fields.name: date_of_arrest
required_fields.description: Date of arrest; used to compute custody undergone.
required_fields.retrieval_query: date of arrest arrest memo custody FIR remand

required_fields.name: custody_days
required_fields.description: Total custody undergone till the application date.

required_fields.name: stage_of_proceedings
required_fields.description: One of: investigation / chargesheet / cognizance / charge / trial.
required_fields.retrieval_query: stage of proceedings investigation chargesheet cognizance charge trial status

required_fields.name: facts_chronology
required_fields.description: Facts in chronological order, one per paragraph.
required_fields.retrieval_query: facts chronological sequence incident FIR narrative chargesheet

required_fields.name: grounds_for_bail
required_fields.description: Grounds relied upon (e.g. cooperation with investigation, parity, custody length). Each ground must be traceable to a source.
required_fields.retrieval_query: grounds for bail cooperation investigation parity custody length medical

required_fields.name: criminal_antecedents
required_fields.description: Prior FIRs with number, police station, provisions and status (pending/acquitted/convicted); 'none' if nil. Mandatory disclosure.
required_fields.retrieval_query: criminal antecedents previous FIR pending acquitted convicted history sheet

required_fields.name: previous_bail_applications
required_fields.description: Court, case number and outcome of each prior bail plea.
required_fields.retrieval_query: previous bail application court case number outcome dismissed granted record

required_fields.name: coercive_processes
required_fields.description: Whether any non-bailable warrant was issued or applicant declared proclaimed offender.
required_fields.retrieval_query: non-bailable warrant proclaimed offender coercive process issued

required_fields.name: prayer
required_fields.description: Relief sought: release on bail on stated terms with surety.
required_fields.retrieval_query: prayer relief release on bail personal bond surety terms

required_fields.name: surety_details
required_fields.description: Personal bond amount and surety offered.

required_fields.name: applicant_counsel
required_fields.description: Counsel name, enrolment number and signature block.
required_fields.retrieval_query: advocate counsel name enrolment vakalatnama signature

required_fields.name: verification_place_date
required_fields.description: Place and date of verification with deponent signature.
required_fields.retrieval_query: verification place date deponent signature affidavit affirmation

boilerplate_structure.fixed_text: IN THE COURT OF {court} — {applicant_name} (Applicant/Accused) Versus State (Respondent). Bail application in {case_number} arising from {fir_number} dated {fir_date}, {police_station}.
A table of case details: FIR number and date; police station, district and state; provisions invoked; maximum punishment prescribed; date of arrest; custody undergone; stage of proceedings.
Numbered paragraphs setting out the facts in chronological sequence, confined to what the record supports.
Numbered grounds for bail, each tied to a cited source (cooperation, parity, custody length, etc.). No bare legal assertion without a record basis.
Full disclosure of criminal antecedents, previous bail applications with outcomes, and coercive processes (if any).
It is therefore prayed that the applicant be released on bail in the above case on such terms as this Hon'ble Court deems fit.
Verification by the deponent with place and date, supported by a separate affidavit.

notes: Disclosure of antecedents, prior bail pleas and coercive processes is mandatory practice (see docs/templates_sources.md); omission risks dismissal.
Provision numbers always come from the FIR/chargesheet and statute sources, never from model memory.
